# Data Coverage Checklist: Backup coverage audit (docs/BACKUP-COVERAGE.md)

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements on *what* the audit must say about where data lives and whether Kopia covers it
**Created**: 2026-09-26
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

Evaluated by the agent at the reviewer's request (headless run); fixes were applied to spec/plan/contract where an item failed.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 - Is the set of directories that must appear in the table defined by one explicit inclusion rule rather than an open-ended "e.g." list? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003] — fixed: FR-003 now says compose file, bind mount, named volume or host-installed files, and names the non-service dirs.
- [x] CHK002 - Are all backup sources named, not just the home directory? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions "Backup sources (plan)"] — three sources from `kopia/README.md`.
- [x] CHK003 - Are the sources of host locations (compose mounts, HOSTS.md, `~/.local/share/<app>/`) specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK004 - Is it specified how named volumes are located and judged? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions "Named volumes (plan)", Research §R4]
- [x] CHK005 - Is it specified how git-ignored files inside the backed-up checkout are judged? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases] — fixed: edge case added (Kopia does not read `.gitignore`).
- [x] CHK006 - Are requirements defined for secrets that sit inside an excluded directory (Jenkins `data/secrets/master.key`)? [Gap, Spec §FR-006] — fixed: FR-006 and an edge case now require saying what replaces it.
- [x] CHK007 - Does the spec state whether snapshot schedule and retention are in scope? [Gap] — fixed: Assumption "Retention and schedule" marks them out of scope.

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK008 - Are the verdict values yes / no / partly defined with objective criteria in the spec itself, not only in the data model? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002] — fixed: definitions added to FR-002.
- [x] CHK009 - Is "worth keeping" (what makes a location a gap) defined? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions "Worth keeping", Data model §Gap]
- [x] CHK010 - Is the rule-application semantics (last match wins, excluded dirs never entered) stated precisely enough to reproduce a verdict by hand? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK011 - Is "cannot be determined from the repo" limited to named cases so it isn't used to dodge verdicts? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-011] — fixed: edge case narrowed to Zuriel's host and paths only in untracked `.env`; named volumes excluded from it.

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK012 - Do the Assumptions agree on how many backup sources exist? [Conflict, Spec §Assumptions "Backup source" vs "Backup sources (plan)"] — fixed: first assumption rewritten and marked superseded.
- [x] CHK013 - Do the named-volume edge case and the named-volume assumption agree? [Conflict, Spec §Edge Cases] — fixed: edge case no longer calls named volumes undeterminable.
- [x] CHK014 - Do FR-003, SC-001 and the data model use the same inclusion criterion? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, §SC-001] — fixed: SC-001 now references FR-003's criterion.
- [x] CHK015 - Is US3's independent test consistent with listing gap services in the restore order? [Conflict, Spec §US3] — fixed: test now covers only paths restored *from*.

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK016 - Can SC-002 (gap lines verbatim) be checked mechanically? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002, Quickstart §4]
- [x] CHK017 - Can SC-001 be checked mechanically against a fixed directory list? [Measurability, Quickstart §3]
- [x] CHK018 - Is SC-003 ("under one minute") backed by a structural requirement that makes it achievable? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003, §FR-002] — one table keyed by service with the reason in the note column.

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK019 - Is the `/x/**` + `!/x/y/**` pattern trap covered? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK020 - Are partial re-includes (Jenkins `ca/`, `secrets/`; Hermes state vs install) covered by the "partly" definition? [Coverage, Spec §FR-002, §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK021 - Are paths outside every backup source (`/etc`) handled without inventing an ignore line? [Coverage, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK022 - Does the restore order require the out-of-band bootstrap (repository password, S3 credentials) that no backup can supply? [Gap, Recovery, Spec §FR-008] — fixed: FR-008 and US3 scenario 2.
- [x] CHK023 - Are services whose data is a gap covered in the restore order (what is restored vs recreated)? [Gap, Recovery, Spec §FR-008] — fixed: FR-008 and US3 scenario 3.
- [x] CHK024 - Is the second host (Zuriel's) scope bounded? [Coverage, Spec §Assumptions "Zuriel's host", Research §R9]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK025 - Is the known inaccuracy in `jenkins/README.md` handled with a documented reason for not editing it? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions "jenkins/README.md discrepancy"]
- [x] CHK026 - Is there a requirement that keeps the audit current when stacks or ignore rules change? [Gap, Spec §FR-015] — fixed: FR-015 added (doc + CLAUDE.md line).

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
